integrity: A symbolic proof addresses all allowed real weights and integer dimensions. Exact finite checks corroborate rather than certify all-parameter claims. First-public date is the initial arXiv posting of the originating primary source.
limitations: The theorem uses ambient Euclidean metric, nonnegative cardinality-symmetric weights and positive hub-leaf edge weight. It does not address arbitrary graphs or other metrics. Literature novelty search is non-exhaustive.
title: Diametral rigidity of cardinality-weighted star hypergraphic polytopes
